---
description: Safely establish a multi-repo workspace, inventory independent Git state, discover cross-repo dependencies, and elect an anchor repo.
---

Read `AGENTS.md` and invoke `multi-repo-bootstrap`.

Validate user-supplied repo names/paths, do not overwrite local work, inventory each origin/branch/HEAD SHA, then discover cross-repo APIs/events/schemas/libraries/deploy-order/integration dependencies with evidence classes.

Elect an anchor repository for shared cross-repo artifacts. Never treat all repositories as one Git history.
